objective: Recover purified, QC-passed plasmid DNA from an overnight E. coli culture, suitable for downstream cloning/sequencing.
summary: Reusable bench-ready template (DEMO). Exact volumes/times/temperatures are taken from the source kit; any value not stated is marked '[confirm with source protocol]'. No catalog numbers were invented.

sample_requirements: 1-5 mL overnight E. coli culture in selective LB
reagent_requirements: Wash buffer (add ethanol on first use)
safety_notes: Lysis buffer is caustic (NaOH/SDS) — wear gloves and eye protection.
Wash buffer contains ethanol; keep away from flame. Never mix guanidine-containing buffers with bleach.

materials.notes: Store at 4 C after adding RNase A

workflow.title: Pellet bacterial culture
workflow.purpose: Concentrate cells and remove growth medium before lysis.
instructions: Transfer 1-5 mL overnight culture to a microfuge tube.
Centrifuge to pellet cells (speed/time: [confirm with source protocol]).
Remove all supernatant; residual medium reduces yield.
Beginner tip: balance the centrifuge with a tube of equal volume opposite yours.
workflow.expected_observation: Compact bacterial pellet at the bottom of the tube.

workflow.title: Resuspend pellet
workflow.purpose: Fully disperse cells so lysis is uniform.
instructions: Add resuspension buffer ([confirm with source protocol] volume).
Pipette or vortex until no clumps remain.
Beginner tip: the suspension should look uniformly cloudy with no visible chunks.
human_review_required: Sample handling step — confirm resuspension volume against source before scaling.

actions: Reduce culture input within source range

workflow.title: Lyse and neutralize
workflow.purpose: Release plasmid DNA, then neutralize to precipitate genomic DNA, protein, and debris.
instructions: Add lysis buffer ([confirm with source protocol] volume); invert gently 4-6 times. DO NOT vortex.
Incubate no longer than the source maximum ([confirm with source protocol]); over-lysis shears DNA.
Add neutralization buffer; invert until a white precipitate forms.
Beginner tip: solution turns clear/viscous on lysis, then cloudy on neutralization.
workflow.expected_observation: Clear viscous lysate, then a fluffy white precipitate after neutralization.
workflow.checkpoint: Even white precipitate; no streaks of unlysed material.
human_review_required: Incubation-condition step — do not exceed the source lysis time.

workflow.title: Clear lysate and bind to column
workflow.purpose: Remove debris and capture plasmid DNA on the silica membrane.
instructions: Centrifuge to pellet debris (speed/time: [confirm with source protocol]).
Transfer cleared supernatant to a spin column; avoid the pellet.
workflow.expected_observation: Clear supernatant binds; flow-through passes freely.
workflow.checkpoint: No debris carried onto the column.

actions: Re-spin and transfer only clear liquid

workflow.title: Wash
workflow.purpose: Remove salts and contaminants before elution.
instructions: Add wash buffer ([confirm with source protocol] volume); centrifuge; discard flow-through.
Perform a final dry spin to remove residual ethanol.
workflow.expected_observation: Column membrane appears dry after the final spin.
workflow.checkpoint: Residual ethanol removed (critical for downstream enzymatics).
human_review_required: Cleanup/purification step — changes affect downstream purity.

workflow.title: Elute and QC
workflow.purpose: Recover purified plasmid and verify yield/purity.
instructions: Add elution buffer/water ([confirm with source protocol] volume) to the membrane centre; let stand 1 min.
Measure concentration and A260/A280; record yield = conc x volume.
workflow.checkpoint: Yield and A260/A280 recorded and compared to pass criteria.
notes: Safe stopping point — store eluate at -20 C.

pass_criteria: Yield >= downstream requirement [confirm with source protocol]
qc_checkpoints.recommended_action_on_fail: Trigger revision: review culture volume, lysis time, wash and elution.

recommended_modifications: Warm eluent and add second elution

open_questions_for_human: Confirm all '[confirm with source protocol]' values against the specific miniprep kit in use.
Confirm minimum acceptable yield for the intended downstream application.
